quotes.text: great car to drive, just wish it had a few more extras like motorway driver assistance, a charging mat instead of a lead, and high beam assist without needing to pay extra.

very nice car, i've only done around 900 miles in 3 months and i'm really pleased. the only negative is paying for so many extras like high beam assist, which you get standard on a clio that costs much less.

very quick to respond, comfy and nice to look at, with lots of features. it's cheap to run and as an automatic it's straightforward to drive. the extra hands- free assist parking option is a bit intimidating though and will need quite a bit of practise.
illumination from the dashboard reflects onto the inside glass in front of the driver by the wing mirrors

the tech can be a bit touchy at times - for example, the favourite radio stations linked to the steering wheel button don't always show up on the dashboard even though they're still saved and can be seen on the home screen.

do not like the dashboard lights, they bounce off into the wing mirror at night and make the mirrors basically unusable. also do not like that i have to switch the lane controls on every single time i start up. boot would be better if it just opened when you unlock with the key fob.
